name: prismstructure

scripts.test: npm run pretest && bash -c 'set -o pipefail; npx playwright test 2>&1 | tee execution-evidence/logs/complete-suite.log'
scripts.test:ui: npm run pretest && bash -c 'set -o pipefail; npx playwright test tests/ui 2>&1 | tee execution-evidence/logs/ui-suite.log'
scripts.test:api: npm run pretest && bash -c 'set -o pipefail; npx playwright test tests/api 2>&1 | tee execution-evidence/logs/api-suite.log'
scripts.test:smoke: npm run pretest && bash -c 'set -o pipefail; npx playwright test --grep @Smoke 2>&1 | tee execution-evidence/logs/smoke-suite.log'
scripts.test:regression: npm run pretest && bash -c 'set -o pipefail; npx playwright test --grep @Regression 2>&1 | tee execution-evidence/logs/regression-suite.log'

description: Playwright UI and API tests for Practice Software Testing (Toolshop)
